title: Dispatch: honor device concurrency cap, serialize per-directory runs, reclaim stuck cancels
spec: Invocation dispatch has three related bugs: (1) the per-device concurrency cap counts every running invocation, including remote/off-device agents that should not consume a bridge slot; (2) two runs that occupy the same working directory (same worktree or project path) can execute concurrently and corrupt each other's tree — they must be serialized; (3) invocations stuck in a cancelling state are never reclaimed. Fix the dispatch logic in the server's invocation services so off-device runs don't count toward the bridge cap, runs keyed to the same directory are serialized, and stuck cancels get reclaimed.
